info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Information Provider Market Data API
info.description: The Information Provider Market Data API facilitates the retrieval of essential market information for banking and financial operations. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can obtain detailed insights about market data through a specific parameter. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, trading platforms, and banking applications seeking to enhance their decision-making capabilities with real-time data. This API plays a crucial role in supporting informed financial strategies and market analyses.

get.summary: Retrieve information from the market data provider.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information from a specific market data provider identified by the resource ID RES-100045. Use this operation to access the latest data and insights provided by the information provider, which can be crucial for data analysis and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information from the market data service for the specified operation ID. It contains parameters that define the specific data retrieval request.

200.description: Successful retrieval of market data information.
